cases.rationale: The crop shows an actual produce boat with its hull and hanging tire fenders, people on the dock at left, and a partial black passenger car at the upper left. Yellow curved banana bunches and piles of orange citrus are visible among the produce. Some small red/green round fruits could be apples but cannot be distinguished reliably from other fruit; the elongated-looking orange produce at the right is insufficiently detailed to distinguish carrots from other orange produce. Apple and carrot therefore remain unclear. The large fabric cover is a fixed awning without identifiable umbrella structure, and the produce display is not a dining table. I considered every other frozen category and find no supported object or unresolved category ambiguity among them.

A black handheld control unit at lower left has a distinct directional/button layout, supporting remote. The Coca-Cola vessel is a metal can, not a bottle or drinking cup. Cables and an orange strap cross a wooden work surface. The cropped red-and-black electronic-looking edge at right could be a laptop chassis, but no integrated screen or keyboard is sufficiently visible, so laptop remains unclear. There are no visible keyboard keys or identifiable mouse. I considered all remaining definitions and find no further category objects or unresolved ambiguities.

An actual dog jumps toward a pale flying disc, and human spectators are visible behind it. The dog's green neck material is a collar/bandana rather than an identifiable tie. Background white seating structures behind the spectators are too blurred and occluded to resolve individual chairs versus a shared bench, leaving chair and bench unclear. Grass and spectators do not establish any other sporting equipment. All 75 definitions were considered; no other category ambiguity remains.

The historical scene contains a human in light clothing on an actual biplane, whose wings, struts, fuselage and landing wheels are identifiable. The wheels belong to the airplane and do not support bicycle or road-vehicle presence. The grainy image texture is not a separately depicted photograph within the scene. All 75 definitions were considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

A batter, catcher and umpire are actual people. The catcher extends a dark fielding mitt, supporting baseball glove; the batter's hand coverings alone would not support that category. The bat, ballfield markings, dirt and grass are outside the remaining frozen categories. All 75 definitions were considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

The foreground contains two clearly identifiable harnessed horses, with additional equine context behind. Harness straps are not ties, bags or vehicles; field vegetation has no pot context. All 75 definitions were considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

A man drinks from a stemmed wine glass at a set eating table. A capped bottle containing yellow liquid stands behind the plate. The background range includes an oven door below its burners; its overhead hood is not a microwave. A curved kitchen tap assembly at the right provides sink context. The food plate is flat, and its chopped food does not identify any listed food category. Thin cutlery near the plate is too small to resolve fork versus knife, leaving both unclear; no spoon bowl is discernible. A small blue-edged food container behind the plate might be a bowl but is not resolved, and the partly hidden dark furniture behind the man's elbow might be a chair. Bowl and chair remain unclear. All 75 definitions were considered, with no additional unresolved category ambiguity.

A man holds a white handheld game remote with a connected auxiliary controller; its hand-held control context supports remote rather than phone or mouse. An upholstered couch and cushions are visible behind him. A timepiece on his wrist has a visible face, but whether this wristwatch satisfies the frozen clock-object wording is unresolved, so clock remains unclear. Framed wall pictures are excluded as depicted content, and there is no identifiable actual animal or other listed object within them. All 75 definitions were considered; no other category ambiguity remains.

An actual bearded man wears a dark patterned necktie under his jacket. The long wooden slatted back with metal support at lower right identifies a bench, rather than an upholstered couch or individual chair. The background pale area does not provide identifiable vehicle parts. All 75 definitions were considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

The open dark cooking cavity, rack and lower oven door identify a conventional oven. Several browned bread or pastry pieces sit on foil. Their split seams and dark interiors could represent sandwich filling, but the crop does not establish filling supported by bread rather than plain split baked goods, so sandwich remains unclear. They have no identifiable cake, donut or pizza structure. Foil and the rack are not bowls or a dining table. All 75 definitions were considered, with no other unresolved category ambiguity.

A thick pizza with red topping sits on a flat red plate; the topping alone does not establish any listed fruit or vegetable. The metal implement at upper left is a broad spatula rather than an identifiable cutting knife. Only a cropped lower portion of a red translucent drinking-container-like object is visible at upper right, without an opening or neck; bottle versus cup is unresolved, leaving both unclear. The dark surface is not identifiable as a dining table from this crop. All 75 definitions were considered, with no further category ambiguity.
